doc: The car radio stub (features/audio/car_radio.gd): stations are looping music files under res://assets/audio/music/, played on the `radio` bus (a band-limited child of `music`) while Rivet drives (vehicle_entered / vehicle_exited). The stinger is a one-shot on the `ui` bus for a completed contract. Placeholder generation: three 20 s loops and a 3 s sting.
